verdict.rationale: Snowflake's SQL reference documents native window functions (running totals, moving averages, rankings) and first-class VARIANT/OBJECT/ARRAY types for querying JSON and arrays, with no extension required. A community user separately reports using window-function approaches in practice. One user notes there is no generate_series equivalent and suggests a JavaScript UDF as a workaround, a small gap in series and date generation. Missing for 10: evidence of CTE support, documentation of rich date/time types, and a native generate_series.
